reason: The text depicts the return of the Israelites from exile and the restoration of the Temple worship, with an explicit statement of praise: 'His mercy endures forever toward Israel' (כִּֽי־ לְעוֹלָ֥ם חַסְדּ֖וֹ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל). The narrative of restoration—the gathering of the Hebrew people, the rebuilding of the altar, the reinstitution of sacrifices and festivals—coupled with the explicit affirmation of Yahweh's enduring mercy toward Israel, demonstrates that helping and showing compassion to the Hebrew people are consistent with Yahweh's character and purposes in this text.
